prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Kansas City Missouri for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your needs (single implant vs full‑arch, bone grafting needed, sedation, budget). Instead of one name, look for a specialist team with documented implant experience. Key things to look for:

- Specialty and training: oral & maxillofacial surgeon, periodontist, or prosthodontist (or a general dentist with advanced implant fellowships/certifications).  
- Experience: number of implants placed, examples/case photos, and comfort with your specific case (e.g., bone grafts, sinus lifts, full‑arch).  
- Technology and planning: in‑office CBCT (3D x‑ray), digital implant planning and guided surgery.  
- Team approach: coordinated surgical + restorative care (surgeon + restorative dentist/prosthodontist).  
- Memberships/certifications: AAID, American Academy of Periodontology, American College of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons, or board certification in relevant specialty.  
- Reviews and before/after results; ask to see patient references.  
- Clear treatment plan, timeline, costs, warranties/guarantees, and aftercare.

Questions to ask at a consult:
- How many implants have you placed? How often do you do this procedure?  
- Who will do the surgery vs the crown/bridge?  
- Will you use CBCT and guided surgery?  
- What are my alternatives, risks, and total cost (including any grafts or temporary teeth)?  
- Can I see before/after photos of similar cases?

If you want, I can find top-rated implant specialists in Kansas City, MO. Tell me your ZIP code or which part of KC you’re near and whether this is a single tooth, multiple teeth, or a full-arch case.
